release_notes: 60 FPS GPU-Native Architecture (v1.3.1 Build 57): Rebuilt Menu Bar & HUD rendering for locked 60 FPS smoothness even on fanless Intel Macs (MacBook 12" 2017) & macOS 13+. Replaces 60 Hz NSImage bitmap redraws with a GPU-composited CALayer canvas + CVDisplayLink VSync, upgrades HUD karaoke to zero-GeometryReader 1-mask-per-row 60 FPS animation, precompiles AppleScripts on a background serial queue, and sleeps at 0 Hz / 0% CPU when paused or idle.
